title: August and the Monsoon
author: Gideon Vasquez
blurb: Isandro Yarrow, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
